rules.check: shared data is read and written under one lock or through one channel
rules.evidence: the line that touches shared data without the lock

rules.check: locks are taken in one fixed order and never held across a blocking call
rules.evidence: the line that takes the second lock or blocks while holding one

rules.check: long work stops when its context is cancelled
rules.evidence: the loop or call that ignores cancellation

rules.check: every goroutine started has a way to end
rules.evidence: the line that starts the goroutine with no exit path
